title: Sell & split
summary: Sell items from a party fund or the treasure pool at one open shop and split the proceeds evenly among the party, in one step.
items: Party → Funds & inventory and the Treasure pool tab have Sell & split: choose a shop, tick the items, choose who shares and where leftover copper goes, then review before anything moves.
Prices follow the shop's usual buy rate, exactly as Sell to shop; items the shop doesn't buy stay unticked with the reason.
Everything happens or nothing does, and pressing again after an error never sells or pays twice. Activity shows one row that opens to the sale and each share.
